item.title: 2026 Election: Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs signs bill that changes primary date
item.description: Arizonans will hold earlier primary elections, starting this year, as a result of a new law.According to the Governor's Office, Gov. Katie Hobbs has signed HB2022 on Feb. 6. The new law will take effect immediately due to an emergency provision.Under the new law, primary elections will be held on the second to last Tuesday in July. For 2026, this day falls on July 21. item.title: Yessenia Norman: Missing AZ woman stabbed 27 times; arrest made in case
item.description: There is a break in the case involving the murder of an 18-year-old who went missing for two weeks, as authorities say they have made an arrest.According to a statement released by police in Biloxi, Miss., officers with the department's Emergency Services Unit (ESU) responded to a home in that city on the morning of Feb. 6 to serve an arrest warrant on 27-year-old Randal Basilio Santillan.Per officials, Santillan was arrested without incident.Yessenia Norman, 18, was reported missing on Jan. 19.
